note: Which venues have a machine-readable calendar. A venue is only swept once its feed is verified: run the calendar workflow in probe mode, read the report, paste the working URL in here with verified true. Nothing is guessed into production — an unverified URL that 404s would quietly cost that venue its listings.

conventions.note: Squarespace event collections; the path is often /events, sometimes /calendar.
The same collection as JSON. Squarespace serves this even where it refuses ?format=ical, and an events collection dates its items.
The Events Calendar's REST API. Present on most installs even when the .ics export is switched off, and a documented contract rather than a theme detail.
The events custom post type over the core WordPress REST API — the fallback when the Tribe route is disabled.
WordPress events RSS. Listed as ical so a real .ics served here is still caught; an RSS adapter does not exist yet.
